description: AgentWeave SDLC Benchmark — Standardized coding tasks for comparing raw agent vs pipeline-enhanced agent

tasks.name: Bug Fix — Null Pointer
tasks.prompt: Fix the null pointer exception in the login function. The function getUserById returns null when user is not found, but the caller doesn't check for null before accessing user.name.

tasks.name: Bug Fix — Off-by-One
tasks.prompt: Fix the off-by-one error in the pagination function. When requesting page 1 with pageSize 10, it skips the first item. The offset calculation is wrong.

tasks.name: Feature — Add Input Validation
tasks.prompt: Add email validation to the user registration function. Reject emails without @ symbol, without domain, or longer than 254 characters. Return a clear error message for each case.

tasks.name: Feature — Add Retry Logic
tasks.prompt: Add retry logic to the HTTP client fetchData function. Retry up to 3 times on 5xx errors with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s). Don't retry on 4xx errors. Return the last error if all retries fail.

tasks.name: Refactor — Extract Function
tasks.prompt: The processOrder function is 80 lines long and does 3 things: validate order, calculate total, apply discount. Extract each into a separate function. Keep all existing tests passing.

M1_firstPassSuccess.description: Code passes all checks on first attempt (no retries needed)

M2_testPassRate.description: Percentage of verification tests that pass

M3_scopeAccuracy.description: Only expected files were changed (no scope creep)
